content:
Answers to N-004's three decisions, from the supervising session under the owner's standing delegation:

1. Root SDK pinning syntax: already decided in N-003 — EXACT-pin @modelcontextprotocol/server@2.0.0 (no range operator) plus zod as a direct dependency, entering the root package.json only when src/mcp lands (T-013), not before.
2. Token-cost acceptance threshold (criterion 6): already decided in N-003 — T-013's measured baseline +10%, enforced as a hard CI gate, not advisory.
3. Third recapture to fix the capture harness (ISS-057/ISS-058): NOT approved — this is spend and stays with the owner. Accept capture.mjs as it stands; keep ISS-057/ISS-058 open, batched behind an explicit owner authorization. Do not let this block closing T-009: the gate's verdict (adopt-v2) is certified on the existing evidence.

With those answered, T-009 should close. Sequencing that follows, in order:
- T-009 complete + session ended -> the supervising session runs the AUTHORIZED history purge (owner's prior timing choice: "after T-009 lands"). NO auto session may be live during the purge: it is a full-history rewrite + force-push, and a concurrent session would be stranded on pre-rewrite SHAs. The supervising session also takes ISS-054 (operator identifiers in tracked ticket JSON) during the purge window, since fixing it is coupled to the rewrite: purging history without fixing the working-tree source just re-introduces the identifiers on the next ledger commit.
- Old->new SHA map will be recorded in a follow-up note after the force-push.
- THEN the next targeted auto session runs: T-010 T-011 T-012 T-013 ISS-055 (the remainder of v0.2, in dependency order; ISS-055's Codex MCP approval-config fix belongs naturally with T-013's MCP server work).

Parked, deliberately out of that runway: ISS-048/049/050/051/052/053 + ISS-057/058 (T-009 evidence domain — several are recapture-priced and all belong to the same batch decision), ISS-056 (placement decided at v0.3 UI), ISS-013 (Windows milestone), 0.1.1 npm publish (owner authorization required per release).
title: N-004 answers + next auto runway (post-T-009 sequencing)
